after-peer-init.purpose: Interrupt after candidate peer-init, before first publication; verify documented bounded recovery on exact source

after-publisher-setup.purpose: Interrupt after candidate publisher setup; preserve exact control/config/store and test reviewed recovery

after-bootstrap.purpose: Interrupt after candidate bootstrap; preserve exact queue/base/actor and test reviewed recovery

after-push.purpose: Interrupt after real remote advancement; preserve R/ledger/receipt and test exact-SHA readback/retry without duplicate mutation

pre-init-no-identity.purpose: Publisher intentionally lacks repo-local user identity; candidate must STOP before control/DB write

pre-init-no-https-helper.purpose: No credential helper; synthetic HTTPS auth preflight input only, no external authenticated push

wrong-remote-count.purpose: Inherited COUNT URL+pushurl attacker inputs; candidate must bind true real origin, preserve attacker absence
